Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office

# Submit a Tip

If this is an actual emergency, please call 9-1-1 immediately.

##### **For crime and safety concerns in Hamilton County, Ohio, call or text a tip any day or night: 513-586-5533**

### Tip Type

Please select(Required)

Select From ListDrug ActivityCriminal ActivityGang Activity/Organized CrimeOnline Criminal Activity/CybercrimeWanted, Armed, and/or Dangerous PersonsTerrorismMissing PersonSuspicious activity/OtherOther

### Tip Information

Subject #1 Name

Subject #1 Alias or Nickname

Subject #2 Name

Subject #2 Alias or Nickname

Subject #3 Name

Subject #3 Alias or Nickname

Subject #4 Name

Subject #4 Alias or Nickname

Location of Activity (please include address, city, state, & zip, if known)

Vehicle Description or License Plate Number

Description

Please be as descriptive as possible. Include as much information as you know about people involved, addresses, vehicles, locations where this is happening, weapons or tools used, dates and times, etc.
